target.title: refactor: consolidate reconnect supervisors
target.body:
Related: #105907

## What Problem This Solves

Gateway, channel, transcription, tunnel, and delivery-recovery reconnect paths each maintained their own attempt counting, backoff, cancellation, and exhaustion mechanics. That duplication made retry behavior easier to drift while guarding live connectivity.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a dependency-light `RetrySupervisor` beside the canonical backoff and abort-aware sleep primitives, then migrates each reconnect/restart path to it while leaving its protocol and domain state machine intact. Exact delivery-recovery schedules, Retry-After floors, stable-run resets, and site-specific max-attempt policies remain unchanged. The SDK package smoke now includes `@openclaw/retry`, closing the packed gateway-client dependency graph.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible behavior change. Reconnect timing, retry limits, abort handling, handshake fallback, and channel restart policy stay the same, with one canonical supervision path for future fixes.

## Evidence

- Exact head `af7688369aecfa08bf7b625726354bc32cb95f4b`: Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxd5jgfamz3t1bjkgnrf50vs` passed `pnpm tsgo:prod`, then packed and installed the SDK from a temporary external registry; `packages/sdk/src/package.e2e.test.ts` passed 2/2, including `packs and imports from an external temp consumer` ([run 29231755533](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29231755533)).
- Exact-head live reconnect proof: Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxd62abc3m4r44es2by59etd` ran the real-timer loopback WebSocket watchdog path. It passed 1/1 after the first socket timed out, the supervisor reconnected, the second handshake and request succeeded, and the original request was not replayed ([run 29232218881](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29232218881)).
- Final runtime patch: Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxd25dqw78xyj8521b4yrbae` passed 439 focused reconnect, restart, delivery-recovery, gateway-client, and retry tests across six Vitest shards. Scoped `oxfmt` and `oxlint` passed with 0 warnings/errors; `pnpm tsgo:prod` passed.
- Exact-head hosted CI [29231733882](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29231733882) passed.
- Fresh full-branch autoreview: no accepted/actionable findings; overall patch-correct confidence 0.91. A separate review of the SDK closure fix was clean at 0.99.
- Non-test diff: 208 additions, 210 deletions (net -2 LOC).
